Welcome to St Mary and St Joseph's Catholic Primary
Headteacher: Mr Francis McDonnell
At St Mary & St Joseph's it is our mission to... 'Do Everything with Love’
If you would like to find out more please make an appointment by calling 01929 462565
Our academy's shared Gospel Values
All of the 35 schools in Plymouth CAST share the same Gospel values. These unite us as an academy and create a similar vision for our schools. They are:Kindness, Forgiveness, Humility, Peace, Courage, Integrity, Compassion, Justice Below you can see how the children have represented these values in their own unique ways. St Mary & St Joseph's School is a member ofPlymouth CAST Multi Academy Trust.Plymouth CAST Head Office can be contacted via: Plymouth CAST,Edmund Rice Building, St Boniface's College, 21 Boniface Lane, Manadon Park,Crownhill, Plymouth,PL5 3AG CEO: Zoe BattenTelephone: 01752 686710Email: [email protected]
